title: JetsonStatus
description: What the Jetson says about itself to the display interface of the H757 on every status poll: the verdict of the safety zones service, the load and temperature of the machine, whether a camera picture is waiting and how long it has been up. The heartbeat is the arrival of this status; the master degrades the interface when it stops coming. The schema is closed.

zone_level.description: The verdict of the safety zones service; on the wire it is the position in this list, from 0 (ready) to 5 (unknown). Anything the panel cannot place is unknown.

cpu_pct.description: Load of the CPU of the Jetson.

temperature_c.description: Temperature of the Jetson in degrees Celsius, in steps of one tenth.

camera_picture.description: True when a still picture of the first camera is available to ask for.
